dashboard.label: Devices
dashboard.description: Step 4 of 5. Turn on gNMI, then uncomment one block per device.

div.p: Use a lab account that can read OpenConfig. Uncomment the matching block in targets.yaml. The usual port and the one setting that starts gNMI dial-in:

tr.td: IOS XE 17.3 or later: gnmi-yang. Earlier 16.12 trains: gnxi.
Under grpc, set port 57400. gNMI uses that listener.

td.code: set system services extension-service request-response grpc ssl port 32767

tr.td: management api gnmi and a grpc transport on port 6030.
In MD-CLI, enable system grpc and system grpc gnmi.
Set system grpc-server admin-state enable, port 57400, service gnmi.
Enable the gRPC server on port 57400. This is gNMI dial-in, separate from Huawei dial-out telemetry.
